Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready pixel art game portrait atlas, PNG with real transparent alpha background.
Primary request: exactly six original fan-interpretation Chinese xianxia cultivator bust portraits in exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536x1024, every cell 512x512. Each bust is centered inside its cell with 12 percent empty transparent padding on all sides; portrait includes entire hair/head, shoulders and upper chest. Same scale and baseline in every cell. No person or glow crosses a cell.
Strict row-major order:
Top left: 紫灵, an adult elegant woman in purple robes with fine gold trim, long dark hair, graceful refined gaze, delicate jade-purple hair ornament.
Top middle: 元瑶, an adult woman in dark green layered robes with restrained gold trim, long dark hair, pale dignified face, resolute gaze.
Top right: 玄骨, a sinister gaunt elderly male spirit with hollow cheeks, white sparse hair, dark robes, subtle contained jade spectral aura.
Bottom left: 极阴, an elderly dark-robed male cultivator, long silver hair and beard, severe calculating face, dark charcoal and deep teal robes with old-gold details.
Bottom middle: 蛮胡子, a burly broad-shouldered bearded adult man, thick dark beard, untamed hair, powerful stern expression, warm gold and brown robes.
Bottom right: 曲魂, a stoic exceptionally broad adult male with puppet-like stillness, square expressionless face, dark hair, muted green and brown robes, no mechanical parts.
Style: crisp detailed authentic pixel art, deliberate square pixels and dark clean outlines, compact RPG sprite portrait shading, Chinese fantasy game craftsmanship. Natural adult facial proportions, not chibi. Cohesive jade green and antique gold palette with specified distinct robe colors. No photographic effects or smooth painted brush strokes.
Constraints: exactly 6 portraits, exactly 3x2 invisible equal-cell grid, transparent empty background, true alpha transparency NOT a drawn checkerboard, no scenery, no background plates, no text, no names, no letters, no numbers, no borders, no cell separators, no watermarks, no extra faces, no Han Li. Pixel art edges remain crisp; all content fits fully within its allotted cell.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready pixel art game ability and mission icon atlas.
Primary request: exactly 18 distinct icons arranged in exactly SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, all cells equal-sized and square. Wide 2:1 canvas, ideally 1536x768, cell 256x256. Each icon must be centered, fully contained inside the central 70 percent of its cell, with ample empty padding. Invisible grid, no borders, no overlap. Crisp pixel art with dark outlines, jade green and antique gold highlights, dark bronze and teal supporting colors, fire orange only for fire icons. Clearly legible silhouette when reduced to 48 pixels.
ROW 1, strictly left to right:
1. One returning jade-green flying sword with a curved backward green motion trail.
2. Three green flying swords spread on a wide circular sword orbit.
3. A branching gold lightning chain linking three small teal sparks.
4. One concentrated thick gold lightning bolt piercing a small jade target.
5. Two crossed compact wood-and-bronze puppet crossbows.
6. A small mobile walking mechanical puppet made of bronze and jade, its feet in a running pose.
ROW 2, strictly left to right:
1. Two separated small clusters of friendly metallic GOLDEN beetles, twin golden bug swarms.
2. A dense concentrated cluster of friendly metallic GOLDEN beetles.
3. A single yellow-paper flame talisman with a curled lingering orange flame.
4. Two yellow-paper talismans flanking a short horizontal line of fire.
5. A jade shield cracking into pieces with an impact star.
6. A lightweight intact translucent-looking jade shield with a slender bright rim.
ROW 3, strictly left to right:
1. An antique gold hourglass with jade sand, representing survival.
2. A jade and gold target reticle around a small threatening horned silhouette, elite hunt.
3. A small circular jade magic array protected by three gold markers, defend array.
4. A fractured upright jade runestone with a breaking gold strike, break rune.
5. A small bronze carrier figure holding a tied sack and two pursuit arrows behind it, pursue carrier.
6. An open jade-lit stone escape gate with one directional arrow through it, escape gate.
Style: detailed deliberate square-pixel 2D sprite craftsmanship, compact Chinese xianxia RPG icons, consistent visual weight.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG alpha, every unoccupied pixel alpha zero. Do not render a checkerboard or any solid or gradient background; no glow sheet behind icons. No opaque backing panels.
Constraints: exactly 6x3 equal grid, exactly 18 icons, exact row-major ordering, no extra symbols, NO TEXT, no Chinese characters, no Latin letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no decorative frames, no gridlines. Draw each requested icon once. A talisman may have abstract decorative squiggles but no readable writing. Golden bugs must be visually friendly and distinct from dark enemy beetles.

STRICT ROW-MAJOR CONTENT:
Top row left: one squat ancient stone rune pedestal with a glowing jade rune inset on its top, dark grey carved stone and antique-gold trim.
Top row middle: one closed ancient stone gate, tall rectangular carved arch and two tightly closed stone doors, jade carvings subdued.
Top row right: the matching ancient stone gate now completely open, same arch and dimensions, stone doors opened to the sides, soft contained jade light in the passage.
Middle row left: a tiny green herb seedling with only two leaves growing from one small mound of soil.
Middle row middle: the same medicinal herb at medium growth, several slender jade-green leaves, slightly larger small mound of soil.
Middle row right: the same medicinal herb mature, many jade-green leaves and a small delicate golden-green blossom, small mound of soil.
Bottom row left: a single small green bottle, rounded pear-shaped jade-green glass vessel with narrow neck and dark green stopper, tiny gold neck detail, no label.
